# Pro tip: "The Problem Solver's" armor (against robots)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_9_nukaknights-post-troubleshooter-armor.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### I keep mentioning it, but now I would like to explain it separately again. **Troubleshooter armor completely avoids 75% of damage from robots.** Since robots are very strong in many places in the game and many have problems with them, this is a good option for many.

On my 5 chars, in addition to my Unyielding armor, I **always** have a problem-solver armor **with me**. I use these **in the silo when preparing nukes, in army gone astray, in cryptic and for example in daily operations** when robots are on the move.

The protection provided by such armor is enormous. You can get a tan from an Aggressotron's beam instead of falling over. To demonstrate this, I'm attaching a few videos to this post.

You can get problem solver armor relatively easily. Most people don't appreciate the effect and sell the armor e.g. cheap in the vending machine. Or if you're putting together a legendary set of Secret Service armor, simply save the problem-solver parts that fall away as a byproduct. This is how you get highly effective armor.

P.S. To keep the weight down for the additional armor, simply use **Ultralightweight** mods or/and the “**Strongly Built**” perk under Strength. If you play with a pharmacist backpack, you can e.g. Take out the first aid kit and play with “Strongly Built” instead.
